rounding: Each RGB channel: nearest integer, positive half-up; clamp to 0..255.

lip_policy.method: Explicit donor-specific muted peach/rose colors; no skin-role inference for cosmetics.
lip_policy.nora: Highlight stays close to donor light; middle stays darker. Deep donors use small rose offsets instead of pale pink. Tongue/interior selections are unchanged.
lip_policy.maple: Muted lip is near donor middle depth, with a restrained peach/rose tint. Lip shape and tongue/interiors are unchanged.
lip_policy.acceptance: Candidate authoring values, awaiting consolidated visual review.
